heroLine: An art collector's estate among Ubud's rice paddies, and its largest house.
why: Place. Six hectares of gardens and working rice paddies outside Ubud, on the former estate of the Indonesian art collector Hendra Hadiprana.
Scale. The Hadiprana Estate is 570 m² for four guests, up to six, with a 10 x 6 m private pool and an outdoor jacuzzi.
Care. Butler service and club benefits, private airport transfers, daily yoga, sunset cocktails and a car into Ubud whenever you want it.
signals: place

privacy

access
Private airport transfers and a car to Ubud centre, 08:00 to 18:00.
rarity
The largest of only twenty-four suites and villas on the estate.
worth: Four nights. One for the paddies at dawn, one for Ubud, one at the spa, and one with the pool to yourselves.
suits: Couples who want space and art
notSuit: Travellers who want the beach on the doorstep
Large groups (the whole estate can be bought out instead)

heroLine: Ten bedrooms on 5,250 m² of beachfront on Bali's southwest coast.
why: Place. 5,250 m² of beachfront on Bali's southwest coast at Tabanan, between the Indian Ocean and the rice fields, with every bedroom looking at the sea.
Scale. Ten bedrooms for up to twenty adults and four children: two master bedrooms and adjoining suites upstairs, six bedrooms below, four private infinity pools and a 20 metre pool with a jacuzzi.
Design. Soo K. Chan and Ling Fu built Soori from local materials; the Estate adds its own gym, spa room, library and a gourmet kitchen, with a butler.
